title: Drill 5: Management of Medical Emergencies - Training IDs 3.1-3.5 (Cardiac Arrest, Pulmonary Oedema, Seizures, Hypo/Hyperthermia, Advanced Life Support)
description: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Managing Medical Emergencies
objectives: To refresh the DMT's fading skill in Managing Medical Emergencies
Training ID 3.1: Cardiac Arrest Algorithm and CPR procedures.
Training ID 3.2: Pulmonary Oedema recognition, causes and treatment.
Training ID 3.3: Seizure management - causes, types and treatment protocols.
Training ID 3.4: Hypothermia and Hyperthermia assessment and management.
Training ID 3.5: Advanced Life Support techniques and procedures.
Discuss basic anatomy of the heart
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedures.
Discuss contributing factors, symptoms and treatments for each emergency type.
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.

assessment.criteria: Meets and demonstrates the basic requirements.
Meets and Demonstrates a thorough understanding.

headers: Management of Medical Emergencies: Cardiac Arrest, Pulmonary Oedema, Seizures, Hypothermia and Hyperthermia

rows: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Managing Medical Emergencies

5.1 The participants will be able to discuss Cardiac Arrest Algorithm and perform CPR ☐ Discuss basic anatomy of the heart ☐ Discuss the Cardiac Arrest Algorithm ☐ Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure. ☐ Discuss and demonstrate CPR. 5.2 The participants will be able to discuss Pulmonary Oedema ☐ Discuss the causes and symptoms of Pulmonary Oedema ☐ Discuss the investigations and treatment of Pulmonary Oedema 5.3 The participants will be able to discuss Seizures ☐ Discuss the causes, symptoms and types of Seizures ☐ Discuss the treatment of Seizures 5.4 The participants will be able to discuss Hypothermia and Hyperthermia ☐ Discuss the contributing factors that can lead to Hypothermia and Hyperthermia ☐ Discuss the symptoms and treatment of Hypothermia and Hyperthermia ☐ Practical assessment
Defibrillator, thermometer Lecture hand-outs and sample photos and videos.

1st 30 minutes - Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos. 2nd 15 minutes - Demonstration on how to apply the above topics. 3rd 15 minutes - Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.

content: Prerequisite: Must complete Drill 4 (Training IDs 2.1-2.6) first

Each scenario must be completed before proceeding to the next.

slides.title: Training ID 3.2: Pulmonary Oedema Management
content: • Recognize signs and symptoms of pulmonary oedema
• Assessment of breathing and oxygen saturation

slides.title: Training ID 3.4: Hypo/Hyperthermia Management
content: • Recognize signs of hypothermia and hyperthermia
• Stages of hypothermia and heat illness
